# Server Rules
- 0. Don't be an asshole - 1. We are an English-language server. - 2. You must be over 18 to join this server. Anyone under 18 will be banned. - 3. ERP (erotic roleplay), or cybersex, is strictly prohibited. - 4. We are explicitly pro-LGBT, anti-racist, and anti-misogynistic. That said, do not discuss specific real-world politics. - 5. Appeal admin rulings privately via the appeal system. Do not complain publicly, nor argue within ahelp. - 6. Always assume good faith, unless proven otherwise.
## Roleplay Rules As this is a MRP+ server, there are some roleplay rules that are a bit stricter than other servers, including MRP servers. Additionally, there are "soft rules", which serve as more cautionary guidelines.
- 1. Mature roleplay topics must be handled maturely. - 2. If a player is uncomfortable with a roleplay, please respect that. - 3. If you feel uncomfortable with a roleplay, talk to the other player BEFORE going to an admin. - 4. OOC and IC are strictly seperate, so long as rules 2 and 3 are respected. - 5. In-character actions have in-character consequences. - 6. Keep extreme real world bigotry (homophobia, transphobia, racism) out of roleplay. RP Rules 2 and 3 always apply.
